inlines.v: TYP'IC TYP'ICAL, adjective Emblematic; figurative; representing something future by a form, model or resemblance. Abraham's offering of his only son Isaac, was typical of the sacrifice of Christ. The brazen serpent was typical of the cross. Typic fever, is one that is regular in its attacks; opposed to erratic fever.
